title: klvsjeju/wf-virus-longread

fastq.title: FASTQ file or folder
fastq.description: FASTQ files to use in the analysis.

reference_based_assembly.title: Reference-based assembly
reference_based_assembly.description: Enable reference-based assembly instead of de novo assembly.

reference.title: Reference FASTA
reference.help_text: Upload/select your own uncompressed reference FASTA file.

analyse_unclassified.title: Include unclassified folder
analyse_unclassified.description: Analyse unclassified reads from the input directory. By default, the workflow does not process reads in the unclassified directory.

sample_sheet.title: Sample sheet CSV
sample_sheet.description: A CSV file used to map barcodes to sample aliases. The sample sheet can be provided when the input data is a directory containing subdirectories with FASTQ files.
sample_sheet.help_text: The sample sheet is a CSV file with, at minimum, columns named barcode and alias. Extra columns are allowed.

sample.title: Sample name
sample.description: A single sample name for non-multiplexed data. Applicable when providing a single .fastq(.gz) file or a directory of .fastq(.gz) files.

override_basecaller_cfg.title: Manual basecalling model
override_basecaller_cfg.description: Leave unset to infer from FASTQ headers. A manual selection overrides the inferred name.

min_mapq.title: Minimum MAPQ
min_mapq.description: Minimum mapping quality for reads. Default 20.
min_mapq.help_text: Reference-based: filters alignments used for calling and depth. De novo: filters coverage-QC alignments only; does not filter Flye input.

flye_genome_size.title: [de novo] Estimated genome size (bp)
flye_genome_size.description: Estimated genome size for de novo assembly (e.g., 5000000 for a 5 Mb genome).

min_read_length.title: [de novo] Minimum read length (bp)
min_read_length.description: Exclude reads shorter than this length before QC and Flye. Default 1000.

flye_opts.title: [de novo] Additional Flye options
flye_opts.help_text: Enter command-line arguments only. Quoted values are supported.

min_coverage.title: [reference-based] Minimum variant-calling coverage
min_coverage.description: Minimum coverage for variants to be called by Clair3. Default 30.

variant_opts.title: [reference-based] Additional variant options
variant_opts.description: Independent thresholds for the VCF file. Default: --min-dp 30 --min-qual 20.

consensus_opts.title: [reference-based] Additional consensus options
consensus_opts.description: Independent thresholds applied only to the VCF file used to generate the consensus. Default: --min-dp 30 --min-qual 20 --min-af 0.5.

mask_opts.title: [reference-based] Consensus masking options
mask_opts.description: Masking threshold for the consensus. Example: --min-depth 10 -q 15 -Q 20. Default: --min-depth 0.
mask_opts.help_text: --min-depth sets the depth below which positions are masked. -q is the minimum base quality; -Q is the minimum MAPQ.

run_annotation.title: Run reference annotation
run_annotation.description: Optional snpEff variant annotation. Supply a matching GFF3 on the first run; reuse a verified database on later runs.

annotation_gff.title: Reference annotation GFF3
annotation_gff.description: Select an uncompressed GFF3 annotation for the same reference FASTA used in this analysis.
annotation_gff.help_text: FASTA is reused automatically. Sequence IDs must match exactly, including accession versions.

snpeff_databased_folder.title: Annotation database folder
snpeff_databased_folder.description: Optional writable folder for verified snpEff databases. Defaults to annotation_database inside the output folder.
snpeff_databased_folder.help_text: Select a folder previously created by this workflow to reuse databases. Database configuration and ID are generated automatically.

threads.title: CPUs per task
threads.description: Number of CPU cores to use per task. Default 3.

out_dir.title: Output directory
out_dir.description: Optional. Leave unset to save in analysis_result inside the selected FASTQ folder, or beside a selected FASTQ file.

description: Human herpesvirus: reference-based analysis or de novo Flye contigs.
